confidence: moderate — direction, mechanism and magnitude are corroborated by the cached wiki text and reproduced exactly by a wiki-legal configuration; exact re-derivation of the scenario's own number was blocked (see limitations)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

limitations.blocking: The golden scenario definition (champion level, ability ranks, item build / AP, cast order, r_spheres, and the manual target's health & resistances) lives in scripts/, which the runbook forbids. It is not mirrored anywhere under data/ (grepped: 'syndra_custom_order', 'manual_target', '5472', '6185' — no hits). The permitted evidence tree therefore fixes the *formulas* but not the *inputs*.
limitations.consequence: The oracle could not print the scenario's number from first principles. It instead (a) enumerated every wiki-sourced mechanic the scenario id activates, (b) tested each candidate mechanism against the observed old/new pair for arithmetic feasibility at realistic stats, and (c) ruled on which value the wiki supports.

sources.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.

Magic Damage 90 / 125 / 160 / 195 / 230 (+ 70% AP); cooldown 7 s (affectedByCdr false). Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Magic Damage 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 (+ 65% AP). Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
Magic Damage 60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 (+ 60% AP). Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath ... increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% (utility only, no damage term).

Magic Damage per Sphere 80 / 120 / 160 (+ 20% AP); Minimum 240/360/480 (+60% AP) [3 spheres], Maximum 560/840/1120 (+140% AP) [7 spheres]. Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 10/20/30 ability haste. Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.
modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge). P = 120-splinter +15% total AP BUFF.

E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.
The engine prices the threshold as a display row and does *not* add execute damage to totals (`_add_execute_display`) — the kill boundary is documented, not double-counted.

independent_computation.step_0_what_the_scenario_id_asserts: 'syndra_custom_order_120' = Syndra, a user-supplied (custom) cast order, splinters = 120. 120 is Syndra's Splinter cap, so ALL five Transcendent thresholds are active in this scenario: 40 (second Q charge), 60 (W bonus true damage), 80 (E slow, no damage), 100 (R execute), 120 (+15% ability power). Four of the five are damage-relevant, so at 120 splinters the wiki-correct total is strictly ABOVE the un-Transcended total. The change moves the leaf UP, i.e. in the wiki-sanctioned direction.

step_1_component_formulas_at_rank_5_R3.W_true: (0.12 + 0.0002 * AP) * (190 + 0.65 * AP)   [12% + 2% per 100 AP of the W damage; quadratic in AP]

step_2_ratio_test_on_the_120_splinter_AP.identity: If the only difference is AP -> 1.15*AP, then delta/old = 0.15 * (AP-scaled share of old). Observed => AP-scaled share = 0.130288/0.15 = 0.86859.
step_2_ratio_test_on_the_120_splinter_AP.first_pass_objection: For a purely linear rotation (flat bases 230/190/200/160-per-sphere vs ratios 0.70/0.65/0.60/0.20) an 86.9% AP share would demand AP > 3000 — impossible. This appeared to refute the buff hypothesis.
step_2_ratio_test_on_the_120_splinter_AP.objection_withdrawn: W's Transcendent true damage is QUADRATIC in AP ((0.12 + 0.0002*AP) * (190 + 0.65*AP)) and is unmitigated. Once that term is carried, the AP share reaches 0.869 at ordinary full-AP-build values, and the buff hypothesis becomes feasible.

existence_proof.config: Q/W/E rank 5, R rank 3; 2 Q casts, 4 W casts, 0 E casts, 2 R spheres; manual target MR = 30; base AP = 964.7
existence_proof.conclusion: The exact observed pair (5472.5 -> 6185.5) is reproduced, to the golden leaf's own precision, by turning the wiki's 120-splinter Transcendence buff ON at an ordinary full-AP-build AP. This is an existence proof of the mechanism, not an identification of the scenario (the true cast counts / AP / MR are unknown to this oracle).

step_3_alternative_mechanism_also_wiki_s.candidate: the 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge (module slot 'Q2') firing in the custom order
step_3_alternative_mechanism_also_wiki_s.arithmetic: delta = 713.0 is exactly one rank-5 Q at AP_effective = 690: 230 + 0.70*690 = 713.0, and 690 = 1.15 * 600 — i.e. a Q cast under the 120-splinter buff at 600 base AP against a 0-MR manual target.
step_3_alternative_mechanism_also_wiki_s.status: Also a wiki-mandated bonus at 120 splinters (Q leveling row + the 40-splinter charge text). Whichever of the two mechanisms the change touched, the wiki grants it at 120 splinters, so both roads lead to the same verdict.

step_4_the_one_illegitimate_way_the_numb.hypothesis: the 100-splinter R execute being ADDED to total damage
step_4_the_one_illegitimate_way_the_numb.test: An execute term is target-health-derived (15% of maximum health). 713.0 would require the manual target's maximum health to be exactly 4753.33 — not a stat any manual target would carry, and math-foundations Section 1.3 states executes are priced as display rows and never added to totals.
step_4_the_one_illegitimate_way_the_numb.result: Rejected. The increase is not an execute double-count.

independent_computation.step_5_case_for_the_old_value: No mechanic in the cached wiki text makes 5472.5 the ceiling at 120 splinters. Every Transcendent threshold at that stack count either adds damage (40 Q charge, 60 W true damage, 120 +15% AP) or is pure utility (80 slow) or is explicitly excluded from totals (100 execute). A value that omits any of the three damage bonuses under-reports; there is no wiki rule under which the change would have over-reported by 713.0.

conclusion: At 120 Splinters of Wrath the wiki requires Syndra's rotation to be computed with 1.15x ability power (P), a second Dark Sphere charge (Q), and W's 12% + 2%-per-100-AP bonus true damage. The leaf moved up by 713.0 (+13.03%), which is exactly the shape of the 1.15x AP buff once W's AP-quadratic true damage is carried (reproduced exactly at base AP 964.7 / MR 30), and is exactly one rank-5 Q under that same buff at 600 base AP / 0 MR. The only wiki-sourced way the number could have risen illegitimately — pricing the 100-splinter execute as damage — is arithmetically excluded and is forbidden by docs/math-foundations.md Section 1.3. The higher value is the wiki-consistent one.
